about: Общие эталоны системы короба swath (ADR 0019 §5; ТД01-2, ТД01-5): ядро — bf_core/stats/swath_frame.py (tests/test_swath_frame.py), окно — ui/src/viz/swath/frame.ts
rules: Angles in degrees: azimuth A of the swath axis clockwise from north, dip D (negative - the axis goes down), roll R about the axis. Normalised: A = ((A % 360) + 360) % 360 in [0, 360); D in [-90, 90] (beyond - refused); R = ((R % 360) + 360) % 360, minus 360 when above 180 - in (-180, 180].

sin/cos of degrees d: d reduced to [0, 360) as above; exact (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0) at 0, 90, 180, 270; otherwise sin and cos of d*(PI/180) (sinCosDegCore of viz/section/plane.ts). -0 is written 0.

Axes: u = (cD*sA, cD*cA, sD) across the swaths; n = (-sD*sA, -sD*cA, cD); v = (cR*cA + sR*n.x, -cR*sA + sR*n.y, sR*n.z); w = (-sR*cA + cR*n.x, sR*sA + cR*n.y, cR*n.z); u = w x v. Directions: x = (90, 0, 0), y = (0, 0, 0), z = (A, 90, 0) - the azimuth turns the swaths in plan, dip and roll of the settings are not used.

Back (axes -> angles), u of unit length: rho = hypot(u.x, u.y); D = atan2d(u.z, rho); if |u.z| < 1 - 1e-12: A = atan2d(u.x, u.y), R = atan2d(v.z*rho*rho - u.z*(v.x*u.x + v.y*u.y), v.x*u.y - v.y*u.x); otherwise the axis is vertical: R = 0, A = atan2d(-v.y, v.x). A below 0 gets +360; R = -180 is written 180.
atan2d(y, x): y == 0 -> 0 for x >= 0, else 180; x == 0 -> 90 for y > 0, else -90; otherwise atan2(y, x)*(180/PI).

back: the angles of the axes of the case. They give the same axes (tolerance.axes); they equal `angles` when vertical is false (azimuth and roll compared on the circle), and hold the whole turn in the azimuth when true.
Projection t = p.axis: 0.0 + the terms x, y, z in this order, a term with a zero component of the axis skipped. local = (p.u, p.v, p.w).

Swath number of a point: tol = 1e-9*max(1, |start|, width); q = floor((t - start)/width), t = local[0]; q == count and t <= start + count*width + tol -> count - 1; q == -1 and t >= start - tol -> 0; q outside 0..count-1 or t not finite -> -1 (k: -1).

Cuboid: limits are (min, max) along u, v, w; corner c (0..7) takes the max along u when c & 4, along v when c & 2, along w when c & 1; a corner = lu*u + lv*v + lw*w per component, in this order, zero components of the axes skipped; centre - the same of the middles of the limits.

Compare: cases with exact = true - bit for bit (-0 equals 0); otherwise axes and corners |a - b| <= tolerance.axes*max(1, |b|), angles on the circle within tolerance.angles degrees, local within tolerance.t*max(1, |b|); k - always exactly.
